description: Service charges for electricity hook up and disconnection from electricity of Cambodia (EDC) 2020 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset contains a list of public services of electrical supply provided by Electricité Du Cambodge (EDC), focusing on in Phnom Penh and provinces underneath of Electricité Du Cambodge (EDC) supervision. The dataset has the detail information on service supply with several types of customer and electric intensity, service fee, and processing time. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Access to information, Administration, Electricity infrastructure, Government services. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2020-03-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
